detail.longDescription:
Enjoy a suite of tools designed to enhance your digital safety with the Verizon Protect security app, and reduce the likelihood of identity theft.

Here’s how Verizon Protect keeps you protected:
•  Secure connect includes: 
Safe browsing: Helps protect you from malicious websites and phishing attempts
Wi-Fi scan: Analyzes your Wi-Fi network potential security vulnerabilities
•  Device health: Helps protect your device from threats and software risks.


With Digital Secure Premium*, you’ll get end-point security for your mobile devices, including:
•  Secure connect includes:
Secure VPN: Encrypts your internet connection and masks your IP address for increased privacy and security.
•  Digital Footprint Manager includes:
Dark web monitoring: Scans the dark web for your personal information and alerts you to potential data exposures. 
•  Security advisor: Access experts 24/7 via chat for help with your security needs.
•  Protect your PC/Mac: Extends protection to personal computers.

With Identity Secure*, you’ll get tools and services to help reduce the likelihood of identity theft, including:
•  Digital Footprint Manager includes:
Password and identity manager: Securely stores and manages your passwords, as well as autofill them across websites and apps.
Data broker list removal: Help you delete private information from sites that sell it.
•  Social media monitoring: Monitor your social accounts for takeovers & reputation risks.
•  Locked folder: Provides a secure and encrypted space to store sensitive files, photos, and videos
•  Identity restoration services: Assists in case of identity theft, helping you restore your identity and mitigate damages.

It’s your digital world. Keep it yours. Download Verizon Protect today!

*Digital Secure Premium services and Identity Secure services require paid subscriptions, which can be added via this app or My Verizon Online.
